name: Numri personal (personal number)
issuer: the Civil Status Office, from the Civil Registration Agency's electronic civil status system (for foreigners and stateless residents, the Department for Citizenship, Asylum and Migration)
note: Administrative Instruction (MIA) No. 06/2016 on the Personal Number (Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo, published 6 July 2016, under Law No. 04/L-003 on Civil Status; it repealed AI No. 04/2012), read 2026-11-03 on the Gazette's own site in its Albanian, English and Serbian texts: the personal number is unique, ten digits and 'encoded' (i koduar; the code isn't given, so no check is held), shown in every personal document and unchanged for life. The Civil Status Office gives it on birth registration (or late registration or reregistration) to citizens, and the Department for Citizenship, Asylum and Migration to foreigners and stateless persons with temporary or permanent residence, with their residence permit. The Prime Minister's Office's draft Law on Civil Status (2023) wasn't in force. No fee, time or use is stated.

sources.title: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo: Administrative Instruction (MIA) No. 06/2016 on the Personal Number (published 06.07.2016; under Law No. 04/L-003 on Civil Status; repeals AI No. 04/2012)
sources.said: Article 1 Purpose This Administrative Instruction shall define criteria and procedures of issuing the personal number to the citizens of the Republic of Kosovo, persons who reacquire the citizenship of the Republic of Kosovo, to foreign citizens and to stateless persons with temporary or permanent residence in the Republic of Kosovo. ... Article 2 Definitions 1.1. Personal number - a unique number given by the Civil Status Office to each individual upon birth registration; ... 1.3. Personal number for foreigners and for persons having a stateless status- personal number given by DCAM in accordance with procedures for obtaining the residence permit. ... Neni 3 Numri personal 1. Numri personal është unik. Ai përbëhet prej dhjetë (10) shifrave dhe është i koduar. 1.1. Numri personal pasqyrohet në të gjitha dokumentet personale; ... 1.3. Numri personal mbetet i pandryshuar edhe pas ndryshimit apo plotësimit të dhënave personale.
